title: Ramp footer
description: A near-black footer: six link columns (company links in white, then titled groups in 60% grey), a hairline, then fine print with underlined legal links, an address, app-store and social links, and a dark email bar with an acid-lime button. On phones the titled groups fold into chevron rows.
notes: forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
tuck pulls it up under a rounded band above it (ramp-cta)
phone accordions are native <details>, no JavaScript
name: ramp-footer

props.name: primaryLinks
props.description: the first column, in white (company pages)

props.name: groups
props.description: the titled columns; they fold into chevron rows on phones

props.name: badges
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: small outlined badges, e.g. app-store links (label + optional icon)

props.name: signupLead
props.description: the line above the footer's sign-up bar (may hold bold parts)

props.name: tuck
props.description: pull up under a rounded band above it
